blocks.text:
You will visit the mysterious Teotihuacan – a sacred center of the ancient Indians, impressive in scale and architectural grandeur. It is hypothesized that the ancient inhabitants of Teotihuacan had knowledge of cosmic energy, now lost, and that the precise orientation of the buildings to the sun, moon, and stars has deep significance. The strict geometric layout of Teotihuacan confirms these assumptions.

During the excursion, you will visit the Basilica of Our Lady of Guadalupe (patroness of Mexico), famous for its legends and miracles.

City tour of Mexico City – one of the largest metropolises in the world. Elite districts and slums, skyscrapers built with modern technology, and small mansions create a unique image of contrasts. You will visit the Zocalo, the main historical square of the capital, where key monuments of history and architecture are located: the Cathedral, the National Palace with Diego Rivera’s murals (***subject to the Palace being open for visits).
